description: Find Vargov®Design compositions by the image or shape of their elements — butterflies, stingrays, birds, droplets, leaves, spheres, rings, spirals and more, in any of the site's eight languages — and/or by product type. Returns LC codes with page links and cover images, best matches first; the brand's own examples come first. For the facts about one composition call get_composition.

kind.description: lighting_composition — the catalogue type “Lighting composition” (almost all of them hang from the ceiling); sconce — wall lamps; mirror — mirrors; panel — wall compositions; floor_lamp — the floor and table lamps section, floor art objects included

lang.description: Language of the result: ru, en, de, it, fr, es, vi or ar. Default en.

motif.description: Image or shape of the elements in any site language: butterflies, бабочки, Schmetterling, stingrays, droplets, spheres…
